description: A single article / section of a statute — the atomic unit of citation. `articleDid` is content-addressed via blake3_prefix12(jurisdiction + statuteId + articleNo + amendedAt) so amendments produce a new DID; lineage is captured by `com.etzhayyim.apps.houbun.amendmentEvent`. See ADR-0052.

statuteRef.description: AT URI of the parent `com.etzhayyim.apps.houbun.statute` record.

articleNo.description: Article number as printed in the source (e.g. '第九条', '§1001', 'Art. 7').

title.description: Optional article heading if the source provides one.

text.description: Full article body in the authoritative language.

blake3Hash.description: 12-char hex prefix of blake3(jurisdiction|statuteId|articleNo|amendedAt). Used as the DID suffix.

amendedAt.description: Effective date of the version captured in `text`. NULL for the original enactment.

props.description: Opaque JSON string for source-specific metadata (e.g. e-Gov 条文番号 + 項 + 号).
